PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://brickschema.org/schema/2.0/ref.ttl#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?point ?ts WHERE {
  ?ahu brick:hasTag "AHU02" .
  ?ahu ?type ? .
  ?point ref:hasPoint ?ahu .
  FILTER(?point = "electrical_power")
  ?point ref:hasExternalReference ?ref .
  ?ref ref:hasTimeseriesId ?ts .
}
